messages:
Anya: Quick sync — need to lock Q3 launch criteria for enterprise audit + BYO-key support. Customers are asking for two things: 1) 7y retention options, 2) tenant-scoped key handoff.
Marc: For retention, do we mean hot searchable for 7y or archival cold? big cost diff.
Anya: We should support both tiers. MVP: 90-day hot + configurable cold buckets (S3 Glacier-style). If legal requires >1y searchable, escalate.
Tess: Security note — tenant-scoped key handoff implies BYOK + per-tenant KMS integration. That's a full ops/SE runway: handshake, rotation, and emergency-escrow. Need OSS checklist.
Sam: Customers hitting us want SLA commitment on audit export time (<=4h for requests). Can we commit with current infra?
Marc: With Dedicated we can guarantee export windows, hosted is trickier. Proposal: hosted = best-effort w/ 24h SLA for exports unless customer on Dedicated or Private.
Jenna (legal): For SOC2/ISO we need documented key custody and proof of deletion. Escrow model OK, but need defined retention policies + audit trail. Also add legal-hold override flow.
Anya: Good call — add legal-hold as a launch gating requirement. For MVP we must: encryption at rest, per-tenant KMS binding, export API, retention tiering, audit trail with immutability flag.
Tess: Risk heatmap draft: High risk = key-rotation handoff failure, Medium = export latency SLAs, Low = retention tier billing. Controls: automated handshake test, export queue monitoring, billing alerts.
Marc: Implementation note: we can reuse existing prefix caching infra for export throughput, but need new control-plane flags for tenant key binding. ETA: 3 sprints for core plumbing + 2 sprints for ops playbook.
Sam: Can we surface a clear opt-in cadence in Console? PMs ask for a simple UI path for BYOK onboarding + status indicators (handshake, escrow, compliance pass).
Anya: Yes — UI + API parity is a must. Add acceptance criteria: 1) Console shows handshake state, 2) API returns export-ready boolean, 3) docs + runbook published.
Jenna (legal): Also require retention matrix doc with region and legal-hold semantics before GA.
Anya: Prioritization suggestion: 1) Per-tenant KMS + handshake (blocker for BYOK customers), 2) Export API + SLA definition, 3) Retention tiering + billing, 4) Console flows + docs. Thoughts?
Tess: Agreed order. Add mandatory chaos tests for rotation/fallback.
Marc: Will scope a spike for rotation failure modes this sprint.
Sam: I'll collect top 4 customer contracts that drove this and summarize specific asks.
Anya: Action items: Marc -> spike (rotation), Tess -> security checklist + chaos tests, Sam -> customer contract summary, Jenna -> retention matrix draft, I'll draft launch gating doc and rollback criteria.
deploy-bot: Reminder: create RFC in /docs with subject "Enterprise Audit/BYOK Launch Criteria" and assign to Anya by EOD. :bell:
Anya: I'll put RFC up today and tag owners. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
